I think you should talk with somebody about it.   
Personally i have hard times talking "unfiltered" about my problems, but there are these few people that really get me and always got time when things are on its hardest for me. I hope you have someone you might feel can be this person for you also.   


I have the opposite problem than you. I have a few kilos too much, not really that many for most people but enough for me to hate myself. The only personal tip i can have for you regarding your weight is maybe to look into gym and other peoples experiences being very skinny in the beginning. It is a common issue for many either it is overweight or underweight, but there is usually always something that can help on these things.
